info.title: BizAI Business Rules
info.description: AI-powered business rules management. Enables businesses to define and manage rules that guide AI agent behavior across categories like tone of voice, policies and info, things to avoid, and FAQ.

field.description: The name of the field that caused the error (e.g., "category_code", "content").

message.description: A human-readable error message describing the issue.

retry_after.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed. Present on a 429 response only (e.g., 42).

content.description: The content or text of the business rule (e.g., "Always use a friendly and professional tone"). For FAQ rules, include both the question and answer. At most 20,000 characters.
content.example: Always use a friendly and professional tone

sort_order.description: Sort order for displaying rules within a category (e.g., 0). Lower values appear first. Defaults to 0 if not provided.

category_code.description:
The category code of the business rule. Determines how the AI agent uses this rule.

Available values:
* `tone_of_voice` - Rules about communication style and tone the AI should adopt when interacting with clients.
* `policies_and_info` - Rules about business operations, pricing, and scheduling policies.
* `things_to_avoid` - Rules about topics, phrases, or actions the AI should not mention or perform.
* `faq` - Frequently asked questions and their answers.
* `client_facing_bot_policies` - Rules specifically for client-facing bot interactions, defining bot behavior, limitations, and escalation policies.
* `lead_handling` - Rules about how incoming leads should be qualified, prioritized, and followed up.

source.description: The source of the rule. Only an app token that acts for a staff member can set it (e.g., "system"). A staff token always gets `user`.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored with the rule, for example the question and answer of an FAQ rule. Only an app token that acts for a staff member can set it; a staff token gets `null`. Serialized size at most 4,096 characters (e.g., {"question": "What are your hours?", "answer": "9 to 5"}).

content.description: The content or text of the business rule (e.g., "Always maintain a warm, friendly, and professional tone in all client communications"). At most 20,000 characters.

status.description:
The status of the business rule.

Available values:
* `active` - The rule is in effect and used by the AI agent.
* `pending_approval` - The rule is awaiting staff review.
* `inactive` - The rule is deactivated and not used by the AI agent.

sort_order.description: Sort order for displaying rules within a category (e.g., 0). Lower values appear first.

category_code.description:
The category code of the business rule. Determines how the AI agent uses this rule.

Available values:
* `tone_of_voice` - Rules about communication style and tone.
* `policies_and_info` - Rules about business operations and policies.
* `things_to_avoid` - Rules about what the AI should not do or say.
* `faq` - Frequently asked questions and their answers.
* `client_facing_bot_policies` - Rules specifically for client-facing bot interactions.
* `lead_handling` - Rules about how incoming leads should be qualified, prioritized, and followed up.

post.summary: Create a Business Rules Bulk Import
post.description:
## Overview
Create an async job to extract business rules from raw text using LLM. The system analyzes content, extracts rules, classifies by category, and deduplicates against existing rules.

## Webhook Notification
When the job completes, a webhook notification will be sent to subscribers of the `business_rules_bulk_import/completed` event. The webhook payload includes the complete list of created business rules.

**To receive notifications:**
1. Subscribe to the webhook event: `POST /platform/v1/webhook/subscribe` with `{"event": "business_rules_bulk_import/completed", "target_url": "https://your-domain.com/webhook"}`
2. Your webhook will receive the job results including all created business rules

**Webhook Payload Structure:**
```json
{
  "event": "business_rules_bulk_import/completed",
  "data": {
    "job_uid": "job-xxx",
    "business_uid": "biz-xxx",
    "status": "completed",
    "business_rules": [
      {
        "uid": "br-xxx",
        "content": "Rule content",
        "category_code": "policies_and_info",
        "status": "pending_approval",
        "created_at": "2026-03-01T10:30:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "created_rules": 15,
    "skipped_duplicates": 8
  }
}
```

Available for **Staff** tokens with `account.settings.manage`.

schema.description: Request to create a bulk import job for business rules extraction

content.description: Raw unstructured text content to analyze for rule extraction (e.g., business profile, email threads, policy documents). Maximum 50KB (51,200 characters).

category_code.description:
The category of business rules to extract from the content. All extracted rules will be assigned to this category. If no category supplied, the system will attempt to infer the category based on the content.

Available values:
* `tone_of_voice` - Rules about communication style and tone.
* `policies_and_info` - Rules about business operations and policies.
* `things_to_avoid` - Rules about what the AI should not do or say.
* `faq` - Frequently asked questions and their answers.
* `client_facing_bot_policies` - Rules specifically for client-facing bot interactions.
* `lead_handling` - Rules about how incoming leads should be qualified, prioritized, and followed up.

schema_description.description: Optional description of the content structure to help LLM understand the format (e.g., "Structured business profile from onboarding intake. Fields: business identity, hours, About Us narrative, services list, service area, special notes."). Maximum 500 characters.

ingestion_prompt.description: Optional instructions for the LLM on how to extract and categorize rules from the content (e.g., "Extract FAQ pairs from services. Infer tone from About Us. Special Notes become individual policies_and_info rules."). Maximum 500 characters.

example.content:
Business Name: Duane's Body Shop, Inc.
Phone: (701) 223-4924
Address: 1107 S 18TH ST, BISMARCK, ND 58504

Hours:
Mon-Fri: 7:30 AM - 5:30 PM
Sat-Sun: CLOSED

About Us:
Family-owned since 1983, no appointment needed estimates, lifetime warranty on repairs. I-CAR Gold Certified.

Services:
- Collision & Body Repairs
- Paintless Dent Repair
- Hail Damage Repair

Special Notes:
- 10% military and first responder discount
- Lifetime warranty on all repairs
example.schema_description: Structured business profile from onboarding intake. Fields: business identity, hours, About Us narrative, services list, service area, special notes.
example.ingestion_prompt: Extract FAQ pairs from services. Infer tone from About Us. Special Notes become individual policies_and_info rules.

get.description:
## Overview
Get all business rules of the authenticated business, ordered by `category_code` and `sort_order` unless `sort` says otherwise.

Without `page` the response holds every matching rule, at most 500. When the cap cuts the list, the response carries the header `Warning: 299 - "unpaginated list capped at 500 rows; use page and per_page"`.

With `page` the response holds one page and a `meta` object with `page`, `per_page` and `total`.

Available for **Staff** tokens.

parameters.name: category_code
parameters.description: Filter by rule category code(s). Accepts a single value, a repeated parameter, or a comma-separated list (e.g., "?category_code=faq", "?category_code=faq&category_code=tone_of_voice", "?category_code=faq,tone_of_voice"). An unknown value returns 400. Omit to retrieve every category.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1 (e.g., 1). When omitted, the response is unpaged (at most 500 rules) and has no `meta` object.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rules per page, used only together with `page` (e.g., 25). Defaults to 25, at most 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort clauses as `field:asc|desc`, comma-separated, over `category_code`, `sort_order`, `created_at` and `updated_at` (e.g., "category_code:asc,sort_order:asc"). An unknown field or direction returns 400.

200.description: Business rules retrieved successfully. The example shows a paged response.

business_rules.content: Always use a friendly and professional tone when communicating with clients
Q: What are your business hours? A: We are open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

metadata.answer: We are open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
metadata.reasoning: Detected consistent business hours mentioned across multiple client conversations
